parse.text:
Floor Drops

Floor Drops can appear on the  Moonglade Marsh,  Torrhus Canyon and  Critter Safari.

Contents

  • 1 Usage
    • 1.1 Moonglade Marsh
    • 1.2 Torrhus Canyon
    • 1.3 Critter Safari
  • 2 Game Message
  • 3 History
  • 4 References

Usage

[edit | edit source]

Moonglade Marsh

[edit | edit source]

Floor Drops can appear on Grass Blocks around the  Moonglade Marsh. Clicking on a Floor Drop grants one of the following rewards:[1]

Reward Weight Chance
 1 Mudworm Shard 35 33.02% (1 in 3.03 rolls)
 100 Fig Log 10 9.43% (1 in 10.6 rolls)
 50 Fig Log 25 23.58% (1 in 4.24 rolls)
 80 Mangrove Log 10 9.43% (1 in 10.6 rolls)
 40 Mangrove Log 25 23.58% (1 in 4.24 rolls)
 1 Invisibug Shard 1 0.94% (1 in 106.0 rolls)

The rewards granted can be affected by  Foraging Fortune and  Hunting Fortune.

Torrhus Canyon

[edit | edit source]

Floor Drops can appear on Grass Blocks around the  Torrhus Canyon. Clicking on a Floor Drops grants one of the following rewards:[2]

Reward Weight Chance
 32 Helix Log 100 20% (1 in 5 rolls)
 64 Helix Log 50 10% (1 in 10 rolls)
250 Desert Whispers 100 20% (1 in 5 rolls)
500 Desert Whispers 50 10% (1 in 10 rolls)
 1 Dung Beetle Shard 200 40% (1 in 2.5 rolls)

The rewards granted can be affected by  Foraging Fortune and  Hunting Fortune.

Critter Safari

[edit | edit source]

On the Critter Safari, Floor Drops have a chance to spawn in preset locations in all four biomes, with each biome having its own biome specific shard, and some biomes having biome specific items as well. During loot generation, 9 of the Forest Floor Drops become  3 Yogi Berry,  3 Wriggleworm, and  3 Bag of Seeds, with the rest defaulting to either  Hunting XP,  Safari Essence,  Foxtrot Shard, or  Honeybug Shard.[3][More Info Needed] Possible Rewards:

Cavern Forest Haunted Icy
 1–16 Safari Essence
2,500-10,000  Hunting XP
 1 Flitter Shard  1 Foxtrot Shard  1 Litterbug Shard  1 Strongarm Shard
 1 Shyworm Shard  1 Honeybug Shard  1 Solsnatcher Shard  1 Polaris Shard
 1 Purple Gem  1 Yogi Berry  1 Soothing Incense  1 Icebreaker
 1 Lime Gem  1 Wriggleworm  1 Shining Coin
 1 Orange Gem  1 Bag of Seeds

SkyBlock Prototype
